canada.title: Snowfall interrupts Saskatchewan's relatively balmy November
canada.summary: Winter is finally arriving in Saskatchewan, starting with a snowfall warning for Maple Creek. Environment and Climate Change Canada issued the warning Tuesday afternoon, saying the snow is expected to begin overnight.

canada.title: Missing Winnipegger's daughter takes push for national Silver Alert system to Parliament Hill
canada.summary: The daughter of a Winnipeg man who went missing nearly three years ago and has never been found will tell his story on Parliament Hill Wednesday in an ongoing push for a national Silver Alert system.

canada.title: Calgary commuters face slick roads, transit detours as snowfall warning continues
canada.summary: A major overnight snowfall is making for a slippery morning commute on Calgary roads and surrounding areas.

canada.title: Winnipeg police seek more victims of alleged distraction thefts
canada.summary: The Winnipeg Police Service said it is looking for people who believe they were victims of jewelry distraction thefts in June or July of this year.

canada.title: N.S. woman’s face and neck seriously injured by police dog: police oversight agency
canada.summary: A woman in Nova Scotia is recovering from serious injuries to her face and neck caused by a police dog.

canada.title: Substantial growth in N.B.'s public service workforce needs review, economist says
canada.summary: A New Brunswick economist is calling for a review of the New Brunswick public service, and opposition politicians and labour unions support the idea.

canada.title: CBSA seizes 81 kg of cocaine in lettuce truck crossing from U.S. into B.C.
canada.summary: Officers intercepted a commercial truck arriving from the U.S. on Oct. 23 after noting concerns with its paperwork, the agency said in a news release,

canada.title: Explosion, fire destroy building in downtown Glace Bay and sends 14 to hospital
canada.summary: An explosion and large fire in downtown Glace Bay, N.S. has destroyed a building and sent 14 people to hospital.

canada.title: Protesters gather outside Confederation Building as N.L. quickly moves bill banning flavoured vapes
canada.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador will give retailers at least six months from when the current sitting of the House of Assembly wraps up, but intends to see flavoured vape products removed from store shelves.

canada.title: Record-high ocean temperatures off B.C. coast attributed to El Niño
canada.summary: The warmer water temperatures mean lower dissolved oxygen in areas that include salmon and herring fisheries along with habitat for iconic species, like endangered southern resident killer whales, according to a scientist.

canada.title: Weather a big contributor to milder wildfire season, province says
canada.summary: New Brunswick had a milder wildfire season than last year, and provincial wildfire prevention officer Roger Collet says better weather conditions can be thanked.

canada.title: Calgary to explore new rules for data centres but temporary pause will go to public hearing
canada.summary: The move comes as a rezoning application is under review at city hall that would make way for a large-scale data centre in northeast Calgary.
canada.outlet: Global News, Halifax Examiner, CBC News

canada.title: ‘Not anymore’: N.L. judge denies bail to man who bragged about Canada's easy release
canada.summary: Justice Vikas Khaladkar roundly rejected a bail proposal from a man who texted the sister of his former intimate partner, saying: "I’ll get bail. This is Canada. She’ll be with me by the end of the day.”

canada.title: Ontario Premier Doug Ford touts importance of joining economic forces with Quebec
canada.summary: Speaking at a business luncheon on Tuesday in Montreal, Ford argued a stronger partnership between Ontario and Quebec is more important than ever in the face of American tariffs.

canada.title: Toronto’s new council is meeting for the first time. Here's who is new and what to expect
canada.summary: Toronto's mayor and 25 councillors will take part in their first council meeting Wednesday, where they will swear an oath of office and Olivia Chow will make her first speech. There are seven new faces on the council floor this term.
canada.outlet: CBC News, CityNews + CP24 + Global News (CP)

canada.title: Can advocates elected to Toronto council help fix housing and homelessness crisis?
canada.summary: Toronto's newly elected council includes several prominent advocates who say they will bring the kind of first-hand outreach experience to the table that council needs.
canada.outlet: Global News + CityNews + CP24 + CBC News (CP)

canada.title: Ottawa spent over $3M in connection with Bill 21 challenge
canada.summary: Bill 21 bans certain government employees in positions of authority from wearing religious symbols, while requiring anyone providing or receiving a government service to have their face uncovered.

canada.title: Sask. woman facing ovarian cancer says expanded drug coverage 'gives a lot of hope'
canada.summary: The drugs will be used for women who have stopped responding to platinum chemotherapy. The province estimates as many as 10 women will be eligible for the drug treatment each year.

bds.h: CTV News in China: Carney and Trump meet at APEC summit
bds.lede: Prime Minister Mark Carney met with U.S. President Donald Trump on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China, as Canada continues to deepen its trading relationship with the host country.
rows: Prime Minister Mark Carney met with U.S. President Donald Trump on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China, as Canada continues to deepen its trading relationship with the host country.
Prime Minister Carney downplayed US concerns on Wednesday, saying its ties are not a "top issue" for President Trump as Canada eyes trade with Chinese carmakers.

Prime Minister Mark Carney, speaking from China on Nov. 18, said Canada and the U.S. have different types of trade relationships with Beijing, adding that in the 'hierarchy of issues' between Canada and the U.S., China is not 'the top issue at all.'
Carney and Trump discussed “the work underway to reach a mutually beneficial trade agreement,” according to an official readout from the Canadian side.
The two spoke shortly after a news conference, where Carney said he doesn't believe Trump is uncomfortable with Canada furthering its trade relationship with China.
